title: Uncraft tool
description: This mod can return the ore for the tool so that there are no unpleasant incidents.
body:
## How to use the mod? 💫
Open the workbench and drag your
tool to the middle, then pick up the ore

![info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d5ba8f1e2aa8e7aa2a479c5f70080f955815447.png)

## What is the mod for? 👾
The mod is needed to get around an
unpleasant situation. For example,
you created the wrong tool, and with
this mod, you can get back the ore that
was used in the pickaxe!

![info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c55c2cd2910718a29934f79ae010e068244a6138.jpeg)
